question: Should document-bound existing-session waits fail closed unless Chrome MCP reports chrome_devtools 1.5.0, while URL-only and time-only waits remain available?
rationale: The patch repairs a Browser security boundary but intentionally rejects unreviewed document-bound custom MCP servers, which is a maintainer-owned security and compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept pinned fail-closed guard after proof
options.body: Land this shape once current-head live Browser navigation proof shows denied replacement documents are blocked and allowed waits still work.

options.title: Require compatibility mode first
options.body: Ask for a default-compatible path plus an opt-in strict document guard if custom MCP versions must not fail closed yet.

options.title: Pause for dependency-level contract
options.body: Hold the PR until Chrome MCP exposes a stable atomic document-id capability that avoids exact-version gating.

recommendation.title: Accept pinned fail-closed guard after proof
recommendation.body: Land this shape once current-head live Browser navigation proof shows denied replacement documents are blocked and allowed waits still work.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned and has the strongest recent Chrome MCP existing-session and Browser security-boundary history for this path.
